item.title: What is linux
item.description: What is Linux? #Linux is an operating system. To a newbie, it might seem like just an operating system, but technically, it’s a kernel. Now, what is a kernel? You might wonder. In a nutshell, it acts as a bridge between hardware and software. Yes, Linux is a kernel created by Sir Linus Torvalds. There were a few software projects like GNU and other open-source software. When combined with the Linux kernel, they form the complete operating system.
